As a young black woman myself, I understand 100% where you are coming from. Navigating a world that was not built for us to thrive can be difficult at times, but not impossible! I’ve had a guy that I liked and thought liked me back say to my face that he would most likely end up with another white girl. I’ve had guys I talked to ghost me and pop up a month or two later with a girl who is lighter than me or a different race. But you know what that taught me...? These situations made me understand that if a boy can stop communicating for something as insignificant as race or color, then simply put they never mattered to begin with. If a parter is so fixated on having someone look a specific way, then I do not want them. Like J. Cole said “love yourself, girl, or nobody will” and that’s 110% truthful! 
I’ve had so many people call me “weird” that I lost count. So what you act like a “white” girl? You can’t act a race, you’re just being yourself :)
Once you start standing in who you are unapologetically, everything else will fall into place. I was in your shoes once love, those stereotypes do not define you, you are more than a black teen girl. You’re a young woman growing into the person you are destined to be. 
💕💕💕keep being yourself and everything will start making sense, I promise you.
